stocks.description: Plug Power Inc. is a leading provider of hydrogen fuel cell solutions, offering a range of products and services for the clean energy market. The company provides a range of software and services, including cloud-based HR, payroll, and benefits administration solutions, to help organizations manage their workforce and optimize business outcomes. Microvast Holdings Inc (MVST) is a technology innovator that designs, develops, and manufactures lithium-ion battery solutions for electric vehicles and energy storage systems.
